## New project checklist

<!-- Delete this section if the PR does not add a project. -->

- [ ] All project files live in a distinct `projects/<project-name>/` folder.
- [ ] The README includes purpose, maintainer, status, setup, usage, checks, and license.
- [ ] Dependencies and build configuration are local to the project; no sibling imports.
- [ ] Setup and usage were verified from a clean checkout.
- [ ] A project license and any required third-party notices are included.
- [ ] The root README catalog links to the project with its own description and status.
- [ ] If this is a Claude Code plugin, its marketplace entry resolves to this project's files.
